# Daughter Dads Unite

> Cause apparel brand started by two Massachusetts dads, Frank Schnur and Shaheen Arif. Every piece is printed on demand by Printful and shipped to US addresses; 50% of the profit from each drop is donated to RAINN (the US National Sexual Assault Hotline organization) and every donation receipt is published. Daughter Dads Unite is an independent business, not a charity, and is not affiliated with or endorsed by RAINN. Purchases are not tax-deductible.

Key facts:
- Website: https://daughterdadsunite.org
- Contact: hello@daughterdadsunite.org
- Founders: Frank Schnur (CEO, Movement) and Shaheen Arif (Chief Coordinator of Campaigns)
- Current drop: Drop 01, "I Am Jane Doe" (survivor support)
- Products: I Am Jane Doe Tee ($29.99; 2XL and up $34.99) and I Am Jane Doe Cap; also sold on Amazon
- Shipping: printed in 2-5 business days, shipped with tracking within the US
- Returns: damaged, defective or misprinted items replaced if reported with a photo within 30 days

## Support
If you or someone you know needs help, call the National Sexual Assault Hotline at 800-656-HOPE (4673) or chat at https://hotline.rainn.org/online (free, confidential, 24/7).
